code='''def transform(grid):
    # The horizontal 5-line separates two panels. Select the color whose
    # pixel count grows more from the top panel to the bottom panel.
    divider = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if row and all(v == 5 for v in row))
    top = grid[:divider]
    bottom = grid[divider + 1:]
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, 5)}
    growth = {c: sum(v == c for row in bottom for v in row) - sum(v == c for row in top for v in row) for c in colors}
    chosen = max(sorted(colors), key=lambda c: growth[c])
    return [[chosen, chosen], [chosen, chosen]]
'''
